queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe", "rundll32.exe", "taskmgr.exe", "werfault.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass", "comsvcs.dll", "MiniDump")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName

alertTemplate.title: Possible LSASS credential dumping
alertTemplate.description: A process associated with credential dumping techniques (comsvcs.dll MiniDump, procdump) targeted LSASS memory.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Validate whether the process was authorized. If not, contain the host and reset credentials for any accounts active on it.

displayName: CD-02: Encoded or Obfuscated PowerShell Execution

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "powershell.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-EncodedCommand", "-e ", "FromBase64String", "-nop", "-w hidden", "-noni")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName

alertTemplate.title: Encoded/obfuscated PowerShell execution
alertTemplate.description: PowerShell was launched with encoding or hidden-window flags commonly used to evade detection or logging.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Decode the base64 command and review intent before taking action.

displayName: CD-03: LOLBin Spawning External Network Connection

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("certutil.exe", "mshta.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort

alertTemplate.title: Living-off-the-land binary making external connection
alertTemplate.description: A binary commonly abused for LOLBin techniques (certutil, mshta, regsvr32, bitsadmin, wscript, cscript) initiated a connection to a public IP.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Check RemoteUrl/RemoteIP reputation; block at the firewall/proxy if malicious.

displayName: CD-04: Scheduled Task or Service Created for Persistence

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("schtasks.exe", "sc.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/create", "create")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName

alertTemplate.title: New scheduled task or service created
alertTemplate.description: schtasks.exe or sc.exe was used to create a new scheduled task or service, a common persistence technique.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the created task/service name and binary path for legitimacy.

displayName: CD-05: Office App Spawning Script Interpreter

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "regsvr32.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine

alertTemplate.title: Office application spawned script interpreter
alertTemplate.description: An Office application launched a script interpreter or command shell, consistent with malicious macro/document execution.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Isolate the host and retrieve the originating document for analysis.

displayName: CD-06: Mass File Rename to Ransomware Extension

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileRenamed"
| where FileName has_any (".locked", ".encrypted", ".crypt", ".enc", ".ransom")
| summarize FileCount = count(), Files = make_set(FileName, 20) by DeviceId, ReportId=any(ReportId), InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where FileCount > 20

alertTemplate.title: Mass file rename consistent with ransomware
alertTemplate.description: More than 20 files were renamed to known ransomware extensions within a 5-minute window on a single device.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Immediately isolate the device to prevent lateral spread; do not power off (preserve memory for forensics).

displayName: CD-07: Security Tooling or Logging Disabled

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference", "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off", "wevtutil cl", "auditpol /clear", "Stop-Service WinDefend")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine

alertTemplate.title: Attempt to disable security controls or clear logs
alertTemplate.description: A command associated with disabling Defender, the firewall, or clearing event logs was executed.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Treat as high-confidence malicious activity pending review; verify no legitimate maintenance window explains it.

displayName: CD-08: Archive Utility Staging Sensitive Data

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("rar.exe", "7z.exe", "winrar.exe", "zip.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("C:\\Users", "\\Desktop", "\\Documents", "SYSVOL", "NETLOGON")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

alertTemplate.title: Archive utility used against sensitive paths
alertTemplate.description: An archiving tool compressed data from user profile directories or SYSVOL/NETLOGON shares, consistent with exfiltration staging.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Identify the archive destination and check for outbound transfer.

displayName: CD-09: Network Beaconing to Public IP

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| summarize ConnectionCount = count(), ReportId=any(ReportId) by DeviceId, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where ConnectionCount > 20

alertTemplate.title: Possible C2 beaconing pattern
alertTemplate.description: A process made more than 20 connections to the same external IP, consistent with beaconing behavior.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Check interval regularity and IP reputation; correlate with proxy logs.

displayName: CD-10: Rare External Domain Contacted by Scripting Engine

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "mshta.exe")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), Devices = dcount(DeviceId), ReportId=any(ReportId) by RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where Devices == 1

alertTemplate.title: Scripting engine contacted a rare external domain
alertTemplate.description: A scripting/LOLBin process resolved a domain not seen elsewhere in the environment.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Investigate domain age and reputation; expand to threat intel enrichment.

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| summarize Countries = make_set(Location), LogonCount = count(), ReportId=any(ReportId) by AccountUpn, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where array_length(Countries) > 1

alertTemplate.title: Impossible travel between logons
alertTemplate.description: The same account authenticated successfully from geographically distant locations within a single hour.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Confirm with the user; if unrecognized, force reauthentication and review active sessions.

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(AccountUpn), Attempts = count(), ReportId=any(ReportId) by DeviceId=IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
| where FailedAccounts > 10 and Attempts < (FailedAccounts * 3)

alertTemplate.title: Password spray pattern detected
alertTemplate.description: A single source produced low-volume failed logons across many distinct accounts within 15 minutes.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Block the source IP at the identity provider/conditional access layer and review affected accounts for success events.

displayName: CD-13: Account Added to Sensitive Security Group

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where ActionType == "Add member to group"
| where TargetObjectName has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Administrators")
| project Timestamp, ReportId, AccountName, TargetObjectName, AdditionalFields

alertTemplate.title: Privileged group membership change
alertTemplate.description: An account was added to a highly privileged security group (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, or local Administrators).
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Confirm the change against an approved change ticket; revert if unauthorized.

displayName: CD-14: New MFA Method Registered Then Immediate Risky Sign-in

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where ActionType in ("MFA registration", "LogonSuccess")
| sort by AccountUpn, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevAction = prev(ActionType), PrevAccount = prev(AccountUpn), PrevTime = prev(Timestamp)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and PrevAction == "MFA registration" and AccountUpn == PrevAccount
| where Timestamp - PrevTime < 30m
| project Timestamp, ReportId, AccountUpn, Location, IPAddress

alertTemplate.title: MFA method registered immediately before sign-in
alertTemplate.description: A new MFA method was registered for an account and a successful sign-in followed within 30 minutes, consistent with MFA-fatigue/account-takeover patterns.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Verify the MFA registration with the user; if unauthorized, remove the method and force password reset.

displayName: CD-15: Phishing Email with Lookalike Domain and Urgency Language

queryCondition.queryText:
EmailEvents
| where DeliveryLocation == "Inbox"
| where SenderFromDomain matches regex @"[o0]ffice[- ]?365|paypa1|micros0ft|g00gle"
| where Subject has_any ("urgent", "action required", "verify your account", "password expires")
| project Timestamp, ReportId, NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, Subject, SenderIPv4

alertTemplate.title: Likely phishing email delivered to inbox
alertTemplate.description: An email from a lookalike domain with urgency-themed subject language reached the inbox.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Soft-delete/quarantine the message across mailboxes and add sender domain to block list.
